author: ETA PRIME
description:
Acer just announced two new handhelds at IFA 2026 — the Predator Atlas 7 and Project DualPlay Mini, an 8-inch Windows handheld that flips open into a mini laptop with a full keyboard. But Acer has a history of announcing handhelds that never actually make it to shelves, so let's talk about what's real and what isn't.
